pre_score_execution_amendment: Before first experiment scoring, exact replay showed prediction persistence later than label entry for most rows. Primary simulator requires common retained input availability <= entry. Keep separately labelled clock-time counterfactual scores, not executable returns. Do not invent later entry prices. No parameter or fold changes.
interpretation: retrospective walk-forward; no untouched validation; no deployment
ridge_weighting: uniform unit weights; owner summed squared error; alpha centered around market owner 100
ridge_trigger: ABC no positive cost-stressed net with at least three positive test blocks; finite market-feature control only
execution: one position per strategy across folds and generations; actual retained entry/exit received times; fixed exit only; no SL/TP; unresolved returns never zero
opportunities: LIVE_OOS completed clocks with finite Market, BroadFull and BroadResidual predictions and positive decision U5/BidAsk; do not filter by future result
fit: valid finite target, label_available_at < cutoff AND exit_time < cutoff; all recommended actions including WAIT
selection: affine penalty: inner matured target MSE; extra margin: inner single-position net, ties fewer trades then larger margin; no outer-test selection
candidate: positive baseline and cost stress; >=3 positive outer blocks; >=50 trades; no unresolved exposure; positive after best-day exclusion; artifact/PIT limits prohibit production qualification
stop: No extra thresholds, features, windows or candidate families after inspecting results
